newsitem.title: USA: U.S. jet fuel falls on NYMEX, Gulf low sulfur hit.
newsitem.headline: U.S. jet fuel falls on NYMEX, Gulf low sulfur hit.

text.p: U.S. spot jet fuel prices lost major ground on Wednesday tracking NYMEX futures, with Gulf Coast low sulfur 55-grade fuel falling almost 2.50 cents a gallon amid a brief flurry of selling, traders said.

Prompt Gulf Coast aviation-quality 54-grade fuel was sold for 1.90 cents below November futures, stable with Tuesday differentials. But low sulfur diffs slipped to even with the print, 0.90 cent weaker, after a major unloaded back-30th-cycle parcels, players said.
New York Harbor 54-grade was offered at about 0.65 cent over the print, little changed from Tuesday, players said.
-- Ransdell Pierson, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1620
